title: Ada bar Tachlifa
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Gittin, chapter 6, halakhah 1, Rabbi Chiya bar Avin reports Ada bar Tachlifa in Rabbi Hoshaya’s name. So too in Maaser Sheni, chapter 4, halakhah 7. At one point there is a scribal error, Abba bar Tachlifa, which Hyman says should read Ada. See Abba bar Tachlifa.

notes.text: The source’s initial ב means “in.” The Abba/Ada correction and cross-reference are Hyman’s, not a new authority merge.
The consulted Gittin 6:1 and Guggenheimer Maaser Sheni 4:4 read Ada. The Mechon Mamre Maaser Sheni parallel reads Abba. The source’s 4:7 locator and Hyman’s correction are preserved.
